entities.name: Lazar's Canyon
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Lazar's Canyon or Lazar's Gorge is located at about 10 kilometers from Bor. This is the deepest and longest canyon in eastern Serbia. Because of its steep rocky cliffs, the canyon has not yet been fully examined.
